subject.title: RFC 0016: CLI catalog view for command surfaces

question: Should OpenClaw evolve its existing internal command catalog into the proposed supported read-only CLI/JSON aggregation contract, keep cataloging in derived or plugin tooling, or decline the capability for now?
rationale: The proposal adds durable public output and plugin-adjacent metadata semantics; implementation quality cannot determine whether core should permanently own those compatibility commitments.

options.title: Accept a narrow core catalog
options.body: Approve a versioned read-only contract with a minimal stable field set, explicit omission rules, and opt-in plugin descriptor loading.

options.title: Use derived or plugin tooling
options.body: Keep core compatibility surfaces unchanged and build inventory consumers from existing registries outside the supported CLI contract.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Leave the RFC unaccepted until a concrete core consumer and long-term owner justify the compatibility cost.

recommendation.title: Accept a narrow core catalog
recommendation.body: Approve a versioned read-only contract with a minimal stable field set, explicit omission rules, and opt-in plugin descriptor loading.
